body:
Most of my books contain discussion questions at the end of each chapter to facilitate group conversation. For Why Did Jesus, Moses, the Buddha, and Mohammed Cross the Road? I created a separate readers/leaders guide. It is available for free here in PDF format:

 readers:leaders guide jmbm

 You are welcome to download and print this guide to facilitate group conversation. The first section of the booklet offers general guidelines that could help any group. The second section offers specific questions for each chapter. I trust you’ll find it helpful!
